**Limitations**

- Slower than ORB and AKAZE.
- Fine repeated detail can give no keypoints at all. On the Siemens star, all of them lie more than 205 pixels from the center, near the rim.
- Only the detector runs. The 128-number descriptors are not computed.

**Artifacts**

- Two keypoints at the same place with different angles, where a point has two strong directions.
